first_time_viewer_summary: Harmonise is a private-first space for people navigating family pressure: reflect, review your words, then optionally explore peer experiences or share with a group. The demo explicitly presents fictional sample scenarios and disconnected services.
technical_evidence_status: unverified; UI explicitly labels conversations, community, voice transcription, AI triage, and reviewer workspace as prepared or illustrative, with no connected services and no enforced staff permissions shown

timestamped_strengths.evidence: Correction card says its interpretation is only a possible reading and offers Yes, Not quite, and Edit in my words; voice transcript is editable before sending.
Community discovery explains its context and says it sets aside broad legal-topic suggestions; no match scores are shown.
Group flow previews exact alias, audience, and question and says no message is sent; reply can be previewed or discarded.
Fictional sample scenarios and disconnected services are repeatedly disclosed, avoiding a false claim of live activity or AI.

timestamped_weaknesses.evidence: Opening slogan does not state user or differentiator; the problem is carried by burned-in caption while UI labels the scenario fictional.
Prepared examples/local rules; no named Meta model or functioning model output is demonstrated.
Community, reporting and staff review are illustrative; screen says no live group, AI triage, real reviewer, or enforced permissions.
Closing 'someday help someone else' states aspiration, not a demonstrated user outcome.

model_claim_accuracy.claim_or_attribution: Replies appear from local example rules; no AI service is connected.
model_claim_accuracy.assessment: Accurate and candid in the UI; no AI implementation demonstrated.
Explicitly marked not connected and illustrative; no Meta model named or used on-screen.
No model is named and no Meta integration claim is substantiated; award no model-role credit.

top_fixes.failure: Product audience and distinction arrive late through caption.
top_fixes.replacement: Open with private reflection first and optional peer perspectives, naming the family-pressure use case.
top_fixes.expected_result: First-time viewers understand problem and differentiation within five seconds.
top_fixes.verification: Ask first-time viewers to describe the product after watching the opening without narration.

top_fixes.failure: Prepared transcript interaction; no Meta model or live result.
top_fixes.replacement: Show a reproducible live Meta model interaction, role attribution, generated structure, and user correction changing the result.
top_fixes.expected_result: Evidence that the model is necessary, correctly attributed, and controllable.
top_fixes.verification: Rerun same input and an adversarial correction; inspect visible output and model trace.

top_fixes.failure: T1/T2/R1-R3 context markers lack plain-language explanation or user controls.
top_fixes.replacement: Explain each matching reason and let the user remove or revise a reason before discovery.
top_fixes.expected_result: Matching rationale becomes inspectable and controllable.
top_fixes.verification: Change one preference and show suggestions update with explanation.

top_fixes.failure: Privacy and sharing flow is only local illustration.
top_fixes.replacement: Demonstrate real authentication, alias handling, audience preview, cancellation, persistence, and data movement.
top_fixes.expected_result: Privacy claims map to enforceable behavior.
top_fixes.verification: Cancel a share; inspect recipient and storage views and confirm canceled content is not delivered.

top_fixes.failure: Illustrative review queue, no permission enforcement or live escalation.
top_fixes.replacement: Show functioning report queue, authorized reviewer action, escalation, and urgent-help route.
top_fixes.expected_result: Clear operational safety path and distinction from clinical care.
top_fixes.verification: Submit and process a report, then test unauthorized access and escalation.

blockers: No connected AI or voice transcription; no Meta model is named or demonstrated.
Conversations and community content are prepared examples, with no live peer activity.
Moderation/review screen is illustrative; report does not reach staff and permissions are not enforced.
No end-to-end user outcome or operational service behavior is verified in the film.
limitations: No direct audio playback/listening capability; sound, voice delivery, music, and audio mix are unassessed. Burned-in captions were reviewed.
release_recommendation: Reject for shortlist as a working submission; continue product development and resubmit after live model, privacy, community, and moderation flows are demonstrated.
